questions: How many oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5 devices did you measure, and how many showed a field-free diode? (The ten pristine devices are counted on p. 4.)
Why were any others set aside?
Which temperatures, fields and sweep counts did you measure beyond the ones shown, including the total zero-field sweeps per device and the field step in Fig. 4?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the other sweeps at the oxidation step where Fig. 2c gives η = 83.61%?

What is the residual field at the sample at nominal B = 0 in each cryostat, after the 1 T field-cooling (Figs. S8, S9) and the ±0.2 T series (Fig. 4), and was the magnet reset? Each sweep well past the critical current drives the flake normal, so flux trapped on re-entry could differ between sweeps.
How do Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16 compare with Devices 11 to 14 in Tc, critical current, multi-peak dV/dI after processing, measurement temperature and sweep count?
What threshold defines the onset current, and how does the 10 μA ac excitation in Fig. S3 compare with critical currents of about 17 to 37 μA (Fig. 2b, Fig. S4)?

Which device is in Fig. 2 and in Fig. S4? The main text names Device 11 for Fig. 2 and Device 12 for the −30.86% to 17.07% sweeps, while the captions read "Device 12 (Fig. 2 in the main text)" (Fig. S3) and "Device 13 after successive oxidation stages" (Fig. S4).
